usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the CSV parser in `main.wj`. It builds with `wj run --compiled`, and a test input made from your two examples produced the expected output.

I ran those examples back to back: the blank line, `,`, `"he said ""hi""",1`, `a,b,c` and `"x,y",z`. I didn't test any other inputs.

The parser also drops any `\r` outside quotes, so files with Windows line endings should parse the same way.
